description_en: You can call the ListVoicemails operation to retrieve a list of voicemails for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListVoicemails获取指定实例下语音信箱列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-voicemails --instance-id ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --start-time 1532448000000 --end-time 1532707199000 --contact-id job-125152394144124921 --caller 073xxxx7539 --name voicemail-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListVoicemails

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Contact Center (CC) instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The default value is 00:00 on the current day
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的起始时间，默认为当天的0时，时间戳为毫秒级。（必填）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The default value is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的终止时间，默认为当前时间，时间戳为毫秒级。（必填）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call. You can use this parameter to query the record of a specific call. You can obtain the contact ID from the softphone SDK during a call. If you specify this parameter, other query parameters are ignored
parameters.help_zh: 通过指定的contactId来查询某一通电话的记录，contactId可以通过软电话SDK发生通话时获取到。如果传入该参数，则自动忽略其他查询参数
parameters.name: contact_id
